title: incident-bot: oncall automated diagnostics improvements and SLO runbook linking
author: Priya Natarajan
ci_status: pass (flaky e2e rerun required, green on second run)
description: Motivation: on-call responders often need rapid context when SLOs or runbooks are implicated in incidents. This PR extends incident-bot's automated diagnostics pipeline to surface ranked SLO-to-runbook links, improve runbook snippet rendering in Slack/Teams, and add heuristics to prioritize runbooks based on recent incident similarity and service ownership. Summary: - Add SLO-runbook correlation scorer (simple TF-IDF + metadata boost for ownership tags) and an async job to precompute scores for high-traffic SLOs. - Surface top-3 runbook links in oncall ping messages and incident summaries. - Add compact runbook snippet rendering (first 3 actionable steps + last-updated badge) to reduce noise. - Add configuration toggles: per-team enable flag and threshold for correlation score. - Add end-to-end tests for message rendering and scorer integration. - Instrumentation: new metrics (incident_bot.runbook_hits, runbook_score_distribution) and tracing spans for scoring path. Related work: follows design notes in ENG-1345 and incident postmortem SUP-4123. Rollout: feature gated by default; rollout plan: enable for internal SRE teams first, monitor runbook_hits and false-positives for 72h, then expand. Backwards compatibility: message schema extended with optional runbook field; older clients ignore it. Linear/Jira: ENG-1345 implements correlation scoring; SRE-987 tracks rollout; SUP-4123 is the support incident prompting this work.
